methodology.comparison: Historical SERVICE + PageUrlTransform sources loaded verbatim from baselineRef versus current production pageUrl query client.
methodology.correctness: Every cold, warm-up and measured request verifies final quad count and SHA-256 of sorted RDF term tuples against the expected dataset.
methodology.warmSamples: Three fresh application processes per implementation/workload; one warm-up and three measured requests in each process. Variant order alternates across trials.
methodology.cold: First request in a fresh application process; common dependencies and query AST already loaded. Includes the modern lazy Comunica import and engine initialization.
methodology.timedScope: Query rewriting, regex compilation, HTTP query execution, parsing, URL resolution, and final dataset materialization. Excludes common routing graph loading, HTML rendering, fixture creation, explicit GC, and correctness hashing.
methodology.memory: Application Node process only, separate from endpoint. Sampled every 5ms and every 512 output quads. after-GC heap is measured after releasing the result. OS lifetime peak RSS also includes initialization and correctness-fixture setup.
methodology.gc: Explicit GC before requests and before retained-heap measurements, outside timed intervals; natural GC during requests remains included.
methodology.transport: Localhost HTTP without compression or added latency. Native endpoint serializes complete responses before sending. Query request counts exclude metadata/control HTTP requests.
methodology.limitations: Synthetic disjoint regex routes; flat CONSTRUCT with all resources matching exactly one page. Shared Apple M1 host; not a production storage/network/SSR benchmark. Peak heap/RSS values are sampled, not continuous maxima.
methodology.sourceState: currentRef plus the uncommitted production source changes recorded verbatim in currentSourceDiff.
